author: The Infographics Show
description:
16 Delta Force Soldiers. 5,000 Ancient Roman Legionaires. No Extraction.

What happens when a single Delta Force squad takes on an entire Roman Legion? In this tactical breakdown, we pit 21st-century elite technology against the greatest war machine of the classical world.

From the ballistic reality of 5.56mm rounds vs. Roman shields to the terrifying advantage of night vision in a 1st-century camp, we explore every scenario. We analyze the sheer numbers of Rome, where 5,000 disciplined men create a butcher’s bill that modern ammunition counts simply can't settle. Can 16 men hold a mountain pass, or does the Roman gladius eventually close the gap once the rifles go click?
